description:
Implement a Java application to parse and analyze web server access logs. A Maven project 'log-analyzer' is provided with stub classes. You need to:

1. Implement 'LogParser.java' to parse Common Log Format lines using regex.
2. Implement 'LogAnalyzer.java' to calculate traffic statistics (total requests, unique hosts, top paths, etc.).
3. Ensure all 10 unit tests pass (run 'mvn test').
4. Run the Main class to generate an analysis report at 'output/report.txt'.

The project contains real NASA HTTP server logs in 'src/main/resources/access.log'.
